description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConfigResolver functions, specifically testing the parsing and validation of gateway endpoint URLs, resolving setup codes, and configuring gateway connections. It tests various URL schemes, host formats, and security constraints, indicating its role in validating configuration parsing logic.
